VI.description: Which of hWnds are front panel windows of VIs that are running - an application's own windows (a subVI panel opened with FP.Open or Show front panel when called\2C a second non-modal window) as opposed to IDE windows (Project Explorer\2C block diagrams\2C panels of VIs being edited)\2C which Win32 cannot tell apart (all are LVDChild windows owned by LabVIEW's hidden frame window\2C measured on LabVIEW 2025). For every VI in memory of this application instance (Application\3AAll VIs In Memory) whose Execution\3AState is running (Run Top Level or Running) and whose front panel is open\2C Front Panel Window\3AOS Window is compared with hWnds. A VI Server call\3A RemoteVI Track Windows.vi calls it only for windows that just appeared and only while no modal window is listed (about 60 ms for 400 VIs in memory\2C measured). The names are wired to Open VI Reference as strings\3B converted to paths\2C library members answered error 7 and the others error 1445 (measured). Errors of single VIs are skipped.
